reproduction.symptom: POST /oauth/authorize receives a cross-origin callback redirect that is blocked by form-action 'self'

data.coverage_gap: The OAuth router test asserts the successful 302 but does not assert the consent response Content-Security-Policy header.
recommended_regressions: A validated ChatGPT redirect URI adds only its HTTPS origin to form-action alongside 'self'.
An unregistered redirect URI receives an error response whose form-action remains 'self' and never includes the rejected origin.
Other restrictive directives remain present: default-src 'none', base-uri 'none', and frame-ancestors 'none'.
The successful authorization redirect remains the exact allowlisted callback URI with code and state parameters.
